A001_assessment_blocks.markdown: ## D01 Architecture informs actual supplier coordination
**Saved direction:** B33-I022-D01, LAW-L2::EA-09 → LAW-L3::EW-P026. **Author disposition:** support MATERIAL with INPUT_TO_DECISION and SCOPE_CONSTRAINT at the original actual-use guard.

The native supplier mechanism identifies external dependencies, owners, lead times, data rights, interface obligations and evidence before incompatible commitments harden. EA-09 can identify which architectural quality or recovery function that supplier must support. In AC01, a canonical quantity representation is sufficient for one consumer, while another actual consumer requires the original record. The architectural distinction therefore changes the coordinator’s concrete deliverable, retained-data responsibility or interface requirement; it is not merely shared use of the word dependency.

The guard requires a real supplier-controlled capability, interface or long-lead input whose semantics, timing or responsibility affects the architectural commitment. C29’s noninjective-payload, criterion-scope and external-origin cases support the technical distinction only. Supplier competence, rights, delivery and continued availability remain separate premises.

A local retained-original design or quantity-only consumer can remove this particular supplier obligation. A direct compatibility and responsibility check may be sufficient. Removing the needed semantic requirement while retaining the supplier name can cause the wrong deliverable to be coordinated; restoring the requirement need not create a procurement suite. Negotiation, lock-in, access maintenance and exit burdens are unmeasured. Reopen on changed consumer, interface, retention horizon, ownership or access conditions.

original_argument.nontrigger_or_counterexample: No external dependency means no current supplier constraint. A promised format that does not preserve required semantics or rights is insufficient, while an adequate existing commitment may already satisfy the input with no new process.
original_argument.cheap_alternative_and_removal: A direct current contract/interface check or local retained representation can suffice. Remove the specific supplier assumption and the architectural choice may rely on an unavailable input; a valid local alternative can restore the function.

A001_assessment_blocks.markdown: ## D02 Supplier conditions constrain architecture
**Saved direction:** B33-I022-D02, LAW-L3::EW-P026 → LAW-L2::EA-09. **Author disposition:** support MATERIAL with INPUT_TO_DECISION and SCOPE_CONSTRAINT at the original guard.

This reverse has a different input from D01. The supplier side supplies actual availability, interface capability, lead time, data rights or change responsibility. Architecture then compares options that are genuinely available, preserves local data, changes an interface, defers a hard commitment or chooses another path. A technically possible external-origin lookup is not an available architecture merely because its function can be written down.

AC01 distinguishes technical recoverability with an extra origin record from actual assurance that the organization can obtain that record for the required horizon. C29’s external-origin alternative, adequate-current-evidence and preserved-consumer cases establish bounded possibilities, not contractual commitments. The supplier information must be accurate, current and applicable; complete quality, organizational feasibility and total cost remain unproved.

No actual external dependency means no current supplier constraint. An already adequate commitment can satisfy the input without new machinery. A locally retained representation or a direct current contract/interface check may replace the dependency. Removing the actual supplier assumption reveals whether the design relies on an unavailable input. Reopen when lead time, rights, interface version, retention duty or supplier viability changes. No universal preference for local versus external control or field return estimate follows.

original_argument.source_contribution: EA09 makes the current quality consequence and justified revision visible. A design that preserves one consumer's quantity can still fail another necessary original-recovery criterion, so a prior phase label cannot establish continued adequacy.

original_argument.nontrigger_or_counterexample: An already adequate stable architecture with no relevant new information need not be reopened. Boehm's conditional staged option is retained; a low interface/performance-risk situation with dominant budget/schedule-control risk is not refuted by the universal countercase.
original_argument.cheap_alternative_and_removal: A short direct source analysis or scoped design review may resolve the new issue. Remove the universal return prohibition while retaining real causal dependencies and change authorization; no total lifecycle redesign is required.

original_argument.cost: Reassessment costs time and may disturb commitments; refusing a warranted reassessment can also preserve avoidable failure. Neither universal iteration nor universal freeze is shown cheapest.

A001_assessment_blocks.markdown: ## D03 Architecture defeats a universal one pass prescription
**Saved direction:** B33-I022-D03, LAW-L2::EA-09 → LAW-L3::EW-P034. **Author disposition:** support MATERIAL as INVALIDATION of the unqualified universal form.

The receiving proposition is that architectural development must proceed once through fixed phases, with return excluded by the phase order. EA-09 supplies a countercase when relevant current quality or reversibility evidence warrants revisiting a prior choice. A previously complete design phase cannot establish that a current representation satisfies a newly relevant original-recovery criterion. Under AC02, refusing the warranted return solely because of phase order preserves a known mismatch between the required architectural function and the design.

The invalidation is limited to universal one-pass necessity. P034’s accepted native rejection remains unchanged. A stable sufficient architecture with no relevant new evidence need not be reopened; an independently warranted physical order, safety restriction or contractual commitment is not defeated by this argument. The native conditional staged option remains admissible.

A short source analysis, existing evidence or scoped design review can be adequate. Removing the universal return prohibition need not remove causal dependencies or actual change authorization. C29’s scope change and payload collision support the technical countercase, while its timing in a lifecycle is an explicit AC02 premise. There is no executed project chronology or measured rework-rate claim. Reopening can itself cost time and disturb commitments; neither universal iteration nor universal freeze is established as cheapest.

A001_assessment_blocks.markdown: ## D04 An enforced one pass rule can obstruct architecture
**Saved direction:** B33-I022-D04, LAW-L3::EW-P034 → LAW-L2::EA-09. **Author disposition:** support MATERIAL as CONFLICT_AT_SHARED_GUARD.

This reverse requires an actual enforcement effect. A fixed-sequence rule must block a specific warranted architectural reassessment or correction, despite relevant current evidence, without an independently adequate physical, safety, contractual or authority reason for that block. Under those conditions, the rule prevents EA-09 from acting on the quality distinction or adequate alternative. That is a causal obstruction of the architecture task, not another formulation of D03’s logical criticism of universality.

The relevant evidence need not prove the whole eventual architecture, but it must warrant the particular action. A speculative concern, unnecessary rewrite or staged process that permits the needed return does not satisfy the guard. A valid safety hold remains a contrary instance.

C29’s recorded collision and complete-source-analysis alternative can establish the bounded technical issue without another experiment. AC02 supplies the real-rule and blocked-action premises. An authorized scoped reopening or direct analytical correction can preserve unaffected commitments. Removing all governance would be a different and unwarranted intervention. Reopen when enforcement, waiver authority, independent commitment justification or a sufficient alternative changes. No organizational delay or rework magnitude was measured.

A001_assessment_blocks.markdown: ## D05 Architecture defeats universal completeness before inquiry
**Saved direction:** B33-I022-D05, LAW-L2::EA-09 → LAW-L3::EW-P035. **Author disposition:** support MATERIAL as INVALIDATION of the unqualified completeness demand.

A bounded architectural question can be meaningful while unrelated future needs remain unresolved. EA-09 distinguishes the quality scenarios and stable constraints needed for the present choice from an exhaustive declaration of every requirement. When current source analysis, existing evidence or a safely isolated probe can resolve the consequential question, requiring every requirement to be complete before any inquiry withholds useful evidence without creating completeness.

AC02 makes the unresolved-other-requirements premise explicit. C29’s fixed quantity and original-recovery criteria illustrate an interpretable bounded question; they did not discover requirements over time. The argument is therefore a reasoned countercase to a universal ordering rule, not an observed learning result.

P035 remains rejected only as an unqualified general precondition. Stable binding interfaces, safety constraints and enough intent to make exploration safe remain necessary where applicable. Vague coding without an answerable question or safe boundary does not satisfy the guard. A short source argument, existing result or small reversible inquiry may be adequate. Removing the all-requirements prerequisite preserves those real constraints and explicitly unresolved needs. Reopen when an allegedly unrelated unknown becomes consequential or the inquiry crosses an authority or safety boundary. Neither speculative completeness nor underinformed commitment is shown universally economical.
